title: Reconcile a committed paper position from its own run instead of the latest in-flight summary
summary: Fixes cross-run read-grain defect from Root 38470273444 in paper reconciliation where RuntimeSummary's latest-per-runtime projection caused an in-flight run (e.g. run146 order_submitted) to mask an earlier completed run (run127 position_snapshot). TelemetryIngestService now uses canonical batch PostgreSQL _event_reader to select a matching committed paper position_snapshot with its own numeric metrics, excluding already-reconciled snapshots, and reconciliation scheduler in main.py selects the paired snapshot identity and its own numeric metrics while retaining operational lag without transplanting latest financial pnl/drawdown or misjoining other-run cached evaluations.

acceptance_verification.description: Fix only the newly evidenced cross-run read-grain defect in original Root38470273444. First evaluation reads newer run order_submitted although requested run has stage1-7 in canonical PG. Preserve surviving same-identity stage7-to-8 obligation of archived RECON-PAPER-INFLIGHT-TERMINAL-ORDER-20261011 without editing immutable archive. Inspect current status/branch/remotes and use clean current-dev task worktree.

Reuse Telemetry owner existing list_runtime_summaries response and existing _event_reader(event_ids, tenant_id) canonical batch capability. Use bounded original recent_lifecycle_event_ids and direct canonical event reader with DB-owned ingested_seq. Select recent committed paper position_snapshot for exact current tenant/binding/runtime/artifact/plan/pool and same causal identity, using complete owner payload and own numeric position_qty/price/cash metrics. Exclude already committed corresponding terminal with causal/sequence guards. Preserve latest runtime UI semantics, fail closed on missing/malformed metrics, retain binding operational lag with own provenance without transplanting latest financial pnl/drawdown.

In reconciliation scheduler, select paired committed snapshot identity and its own numeric metrics before evaluation/terminal construction. Never transplant older snapshot identity onto newer latest-summary financial metrics or cached evaluation from another run. Handle evaluation cache without misjoining cached pending/newer evaluations; same-window replay emits one deterministic stage 8 terminal.
acceptance_verification.verdict: pass: persist-before-send stores deterministic evaluation and terminal intent in store before network append so SLA breach, business failure, or claim reacquisition preserves candidate A evaluation, receipt, and metrics without retargeting deterministic event_id to candidate B. In lifecycle-only mode (where test414-472 explicitly forbids evaluation store rows), ephemeral local seen_evaluations dict was removed and deduplication is reconciled with Telemetry owner discovery via _fetch_telemetry_accepted_event (GET /api/telemetry/events/{event_id}), preserving candidate A without emitting candidate B. Architectural boundary documented: under the lifecycle-only no-evaluation-store contract, accepted events are durably recovered from Telemetry owner, whereas in-flight unaccepted network timeouts cannot recover unpersisted intent without an evaluation store.

Cover cached pending/newer-run evaluation versus completed snapshot to prevent result/identity misjoin; same-window replay remains one deterministic stage 8 terminal.
